title: Apple Juice with Vitamin C, From Concentrate, Shelf Stable

content.title: About
content.content: Apple juice made from concentrate, enriched with vitamin C and packaged as a shelf‑stable product. The juice retains the fresh apple aroma, while added vitamin C boosts its nutritional value and helps preserve colour.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Concentrated juice takes up less space and is easier to transport than fresh‑pressed juice.
Vitamin C is stabilised with antioxidants, allowing it to remain active throughout a long shelf life.
Apple juice naturally contains pectins that may support digestive health.
Concentrated juice is often used in cooking for sauces, marinades, and desserts.
In Russia and CIS countries this product is commonly labelled as “shelf stable”.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system, collagen synthesis and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Source of antioxidants
items.content: In addition to vitamin C, the juice contains polyphenols that help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Pectin in apple juice can aid regular bowel function.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The juice is mostly water, helping maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Apple juice contains virtually no fat, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Concentrated juice may contain added sugars; people monitoring glucose levels should consider its calories.

items.title: Apple allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to apples or apple derivatives.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The acidity can irritate sensitive teeth or the stomach if consumed in excess.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Shelf‑stable products may contain preservatives; those avoiding additives should check the label.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drink chilled, add to smoothies, cocktails, culinary sauces, or use as a base for fruit punches. It can be diluted with water to reduce sweetness if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 7–10 days.
